title: 12043-FRLA-ALARM MONITORING CONTRACT
description: The National Park Service has a requirement for Alarm Monitoring services at Multiple Sites:  Frederick Law Olmsted National Historic Site (FRLA), Longfellow-Washington's Headquarters National Historic Site (LONG), John F. Kennedy National Historic Site (JOFI), and Designated Maintenance Facility.  The contractor shall provide alarm monitoring services. No installation shall be required. The systems that need monitoring are intrusion, telecommunications, and fire protection. The alarm systems that need to be monitored already exist in each of the buildings. This contract will also provide monthly electronic reporting of activity at the aforementioned. Alarm monitoring services are to be provided 24 hours a day, 365 days a year for the life of this contract. Service repairs when needed shall be available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year for the life of this contract.
